en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Muhammad Bin Al Fazeyl, from Abu Al Sabbah Al Kinany who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who says, ‘Upon me is a vow’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The vow is not with anything until he names something for the Sake of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, a Fast, or a charity, or an offering, or Hajj’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il from Muhammad af-Fudayi from abu af-Sabbah ai-Kinaniy who has narrated the foffowing:

“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who says that there is a vow, a commitment on him (the Imam) said, ‘It does not have any valid effect until one specifies it, like fasting, charity, a gift or al-Hajj.’”
